 For Applicant : Mr. Y.C. Sharma, Senior Advocate with
 Ms. Pooja Loniya, Advocate
 For State : Mr. Aditya Bhardwaj, Panel Lawyer
 Prosecutrix and her mother are also present in the Court.
S.B.: Hon'ble Shri Parth Prateem Sahu, Judge

Order On Board
17/08/2023
 1.

Applicant has filed this application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail as he has been arrested in connection with Crime No.212/2022 registered at Police Station- Amanaka,
District-Raipur (CG) for the offence punishable under Sections 376 (3), 109 IPC and Sections 4, 5 (g), 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.
2.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: This is the second bail application of the applicant.
3. Case of the prosecution in brief is that co-accused Pradeep Boparai has established physical relation with the victim (minor) after giving intoxicated injection.

Based on the report lodged that the co-accused/main accused has established physical relation with the victim in the truck and also in the lodge owned by applicant, applicant was also made one of the accused and he was arrested on 16.02.2023.

1 4.

entities.text: Tajinder Singh @ Lucky vs State Of Chhattisgarh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that after arrest of the applicant, victim and her mother were examined before the trial Court, however, the victim has not named the lodge where the alleged offence has been committed by the co-accused.

He further submits that the victim was declared as hostile witnesses by the prosecution and the mother of the victim has stated that the victim has not complained to her that she was subjected to physical assault in the lodge also.
Therefore, the applicant may be released on bail.

5. Learned counsel for the State opposes the submission of learned counsel for the applicant and submits that the serious allegations are levelled against the co-accused and further there is allegation in the case diary that the applicant facilitated the co- accused for commission of offence.
6. I have heard learned counsel for the parties.
7. The applicant has filed the deposition sheet of the victim and her mother.

Considering the contents of deposition sheet as also allegation which are in the charge sheet that applicant is the owner of lodge where the offence is alleged to have been committed and further considering the period of detention of the applicant, without commenting anything on merits of the case, I am inclined to allow the bail application.
8.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on regular bail on his furnishing a bail bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one surety in the like sum to the satisfaction of the Court on the conditions that:-
a) Applicant shall appear before the trial Court regularly on each and every date,
unless exempted from appearance.
b) Applicant shall not, in any manner, tamper with the prosecution witnesses.
c)
If the applicant is found involved in similar offence in the future, it will be open for the State to apply for cancellation of Bail.
Certified copy as per rules.

Sd/-/----/---/-/---/-/-
(Parth Prateem Sahu) Judge Praveen Tajinder Singh @ Lucky vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 17 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128598261/
